class.name: SourcePPMDL
class.brief_description: Allows reading Source Engine MDL model triplets through the bundled SourcePP library.
class.description:
[SourcePPMDL] exposes a first-cut wrapper over SourcePP's MDL support for scripts. It opens a model from the required [code].mdl[/code], [code].vtx[/code], and [code].vvd[/code] files, exposes basic metadata, and can bake the chosen LOD into a Godot [ArrayMesh]. If the model references external Source animation blocks, [method open] tries to resolve the companion [code].ani[/code] blob automatically and [method open_from_buffer] can accept it explicitly. If [param vtx_path] or [param vvd_path] are omitted when calling [method open], the wrapper tries to resolve common companion filenames next to the MDL automatically. [codeblock] var mdl := SourcePPMDL.new() if mdl.open("user://props/crate01.mdl") != OK: return
print(mdl.get_materials()) var mesh := mdl.create_mesh(0) print(mesh.get_surface_count()) [/codeblock]

method.name: close
method.description: Releases the currently loaded model.

method.name: create_mesh
method.description: Builds a Godot [ArrayMesh] for the selected LOD. One surface is created per baked MDL mesh, with surface names set from the resolved material names when available.

method.name: create_sequence_animation
method.description: Builds a Godot [Animation] for the selected sequence blend by sampling the referenced local animation descriptor and creating [code]TYPE_POSITION_3D[/code] and [code]TYPE_ROTATION_3D[/code] tracks against [param skeleton_path]. Sequence events are added as animation markers. If the model references external Source animation blocks, [method open] tries to resolve the companion [code].ani[/code] blob automatically.

method.name: get_attachment_count
method.description: Returns the number of parsed attachments.

method.name: get_attachments
method.description: Returns the parsed attachments as dictionaries. Each dictionary contains [code]name[/code], [code]flags[/code], [code]bone[/code], [code]bone_name[/code], and [code]transform[/code].

method.name: get_animation_descriptor_count
method.description: Returns the number of parsed local animation descriptors.

method.name: get_animation_descriptors
method.description: Returns parsed animation descriptors as dictionaries. Each dictionary contains [code]name[/code], [code]fps[/code], [code]flags[/code], [code]frame_count[/code], [code]anim_block[/code], [code]anim_index[/code], [code]ik_rule_count[/code], [code]local_hierarchy_count[/code], [code]section_index[/code], [code]section_frames[/code], [code]zero_frame_span[/code], [code]zero_frame_count[/code], [code]zero_frame_index[/code], [code]zero_frame_stall_time[/code], [code]has_inline_animation_data[/code], and [code]movements[/code].

method.name: get_animation_data
method.description: Samples a local animation descriptor into import-friendly data. The returned dictionary contains [code]animation_descriptor[/code], [code]fps[/code], [code]frame_count[/code], [code]flags[/code], [code]length[/code], and [code]tracks[/code]. Each entry in [code]tracks[/code] is a dictionary with [code]bone[/code], [code]bone_name[/code], [code]positions[/code] as a [PackedVector3Array], and [code]rotations[/code] as an [Array] of [Quaternion] values. If the model references external Source animation blocks, [method open] tries to resolve the companion [code].ani[/code] blob automatically.

method.name: get_body_parts
method.description: Returns the MDL body part names.

method.name: get_bone_names
method.description: Returns the parsed bone names.

method.name: get_checksum
method.description: Returns the MDL checksum value used to match companion files.

method.name: get_hitbox_set_count
method.description: Returns the number of parsed hitbox sets.

method.name: get_hitbox_set_names
method.description: Returns the hitbox set names.

method.name: get_hitboxes
method.description: Returns the hitboxes for the requested set as dictionaries. Each dictionary contains [code]name[/code], [code]bone[/code], [code]bone_name[/code], [code]group[/code], [code]min[/code], and [code]max[/code].

method.name: get_lod_count
method.description: Returns the number of available LODs according to the VTX data.

method.name: get_material_directories
method.description: Returns the material search directories stored in the MDL.

method.name: get_materials
method.description: Returns the material names referenced by the model.

method.name: get_mdl_path
method.description: Returns the last opened MDL path, or an empty string if the model was loaded from memory.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the MDL header name.

method.name: get_sequence_descriptor_count
method.description: Returns the number of parsed local sequence descriptors.

method.name: get_sequence_descriptors
method.description: Returns parsed sequence descriptors as dictionaries. Each dictionary contains [code]label[/code], [code]activity_name[/code], [code]flags[/code], [code]activity[/code], [code]activity_weight[/code], [code]event_count[/code], [code]bounding_box_min[/code], [code]bounding_box_max[/code], [code]blend_count[/code], [code]group_size[/code], [code]param_index[/code], [code]param_start[/code], [code]param_end[/code], [code]param_parent[/code], [code]fade_in_time[/code], [code]fade_out_time[/code], [code]local_entry_node[/code], [code]local_exit_node[/code], [code]node_flags[/code], [code]entry_phase[/code], [code]exit_phase[/code], [code]last_frame[/code], [code]next_sequence[/code], [code]pose[/code], [code]ik_rule_count[/code], [code]auto_layer_count[/code], [code]ik_lock_count[/code], [code]cycle_pose_index[/code], [code]animation_indices[/code], [code]events[/code], [code]auto_layers[/code], [code]bone_weights[/code], [code]pose_keys[/code], [code]activity_modifiers[/code], and [code]key_value_text[/code].

method.name: get_skin_families
method.description: Returns the parsed skin families. Each entry is a [PackedInt32Array] of material indices into [method get_materials].

method.name: get_surface_count
method.description: Returns the number of baked mesh surfaces for the selected LOD.

method.name: get_surface_material_indices
method.description: Returns the material indices for the baked surfaces at the selected LOD.

method.name: get_surface_materials
method.description: Returns the resolved material names for the baked surfaces at the selected LOD.

method.name: get_vertex_count
method.description: Returns the baked vertex count for the selected LOD.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns the parsed MDL version.

method.name: get_vtx_path
method.description: Returns the last opened VTX companion path, or an empty string if the model was loaded from memory.

method.name: get_vvd_path
method.description: Returns the last opened VVD companion path, or an empty string if the model was loaded from memory.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a model is currently loaded.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens a model from disk. If [param vtx_path] or [param vvd_path] are empty, common companion filenames next to [param mdl_path] are tried automatically.

method.name: open_from_buffer
method.description: Opens a model from in-memory MDL, VTX, and VVD bytes. If the model references external Source animation blocks, pass the companion [code].ani[/code] blob in [param anim_block_data].
